snippet.title: ALL ADRIFT - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
“Whether its end is dark or bright, create a religion for a fabricated god and perform surgery on the history of the universe. Strive to understand all things in the universe that mere humans cannot know. For now, survive like that.”

Face the history laid upon the operating table, and the countenance of humanity.
Drift atop the records of sin humanity has left behind, and answer for the meaning of existence and salvation.
Whether in darkness or in light, walk upon the edge of humankind’s end, and bare your most human self.
